If selected for the position of Data Analyst, you will provide analysis and intelligence concerning consumer reports, information obtained during law enforcement investigations and actions, and other data maintained by the FTC.

As part of your responsibilities, you will support the Consumer Sentinel Network (CSN) and other law enforcement efforts and agency priorities. Consumer Sentinel is a secure online tool available to law enforcement authorities throughout the United States and abroad.

It includes a searchable data bank of consumer reports about fraud, scams, and bad business practices received by the FTC and external data contributors. In this position, you will support multiple FTC/BCP program areas, including anti-fraud, identity theft, Do Not Call, and Take it Down Act enforcement, as well as the consumer redress program.

You will perform the following duties: - Develop methods to extract and analyze data from CSN or from data obtained during the course of investigations and to transmit this information to the appropriate internal and external users, including FTC management and staff at all levels as well as external parties including members of Congress, federal and state governmental agencies, FOIA requesters, and others. - Leverage analytics and visualization tools (Tableau) to present information in a way that drives fact-based decision-making. - Automate and optimize data extraction, cleaning, processing, and analysis functions. - Analyze, clean, and process sensitive consumer data collected in various mediums, converting the data into a uniform standardized format for use in redress activities. - Produce descriptive statistics for a wide range of law enforcement efforts. - Query and mine large datasets, including text data, to discover patterns, using traditional or advanced techniques such as large language models. - Regularly use various relational databases, SQL Server, MYSQL, etc. to query databases. - Use MS Excel, Python (including Pandas, Numpy), R, and other programming languages to analyze large datasets of structured or unstructured data. - Leverage emerging artificial intelligence and big data tools to analyze large datasets and streamline processes. - Energetically work with teams to create data products for a wide range of stakeholders, including drafting declarations and other written materials that clearly and accurately describe data findings and analytical conclusions to prove allegations in court.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Collaborate with our principals to refine our analytical approach for specific client problems.

Logical rigor and the intellectual honesty to admit when the data does not support a current hypothesis.
Basic familiarity with spreadsheets and a structured approach to problem solving.

The self-discipline to manage tasks and meet deadlines in a fully remote setting.

3106 - Senior Data Governance Analyst - UK

The MFG team is seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Data Governance Analyst to join our global Data Governance team. This pivotal role will be responsible for driving quality assurance oversight on critical business processes where data is collected, stored, transformed, or used.

You will take ownership of identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex data quality issues, leading coordination efforts with internal and external teams.

As a Senior Analyst, you will also independently manage and contribute significantly to strategic Data Governance initiatives, helping to define and implement best practices across the organization.

Lead the end-to-end delivery of weekly dashboards that evaluate datasets for quality and accuracy, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
Actively assist and contribute to the development efforts in building and enhancing dashboards that evaluate datasets for quality and accuracy.
Drive and oversee data cleansing efforts, including the identification, assessment, and proactive resolution of complex and systemic data quality issues.
Engage with stakeholders and the internal Data Governance team to proactively address root causes of poor data quality and recommend sustainable improvements.
Independently execute and manage business-as-usual (BAU) tasks derived from ongoing Data Governance projects, ensuring operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Act as a primary point of contact and trusted data expert, collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot intricate data quality errors and facilitate timely, robust issue resolution.
Develop and implement frameworks to continuously monitor and report on the progress of data quality improvements, translating metrics into strategic insights and identifying trends.
Proactively identify areas for process and tool enhancement, leading the development and implementation of innovative solutions to significantly uplift overall data quality, efficiency, and scalability.
Champion the importance of data excellence and actively engage cross-discipline teams to uplift data literacy across the business.
Develop, document, and enforce comprehensive data processes, standards, and policies to foster a robust culture of data excellence and compliance.
Take ownership of key components of internal or client projects and drive them to completion.
Lead and actively contribute to various Data Governance projects and initiatives (such as Data Quality Stewardship and Taxonomy), taking responsibility for specific workstreams or deliverables as required.
When necessary, draft client communications and presentations for internal review before distribution.

Progressive experience in a data analysis, data quality, or data governance role, ideally within a complex data environment.
Strong command of written and spoken English
Strong, independent problem-solving skills, coupled with a highly methodical and analytical approach to complex data challenges.
Exceptional attention to detail and a meticulous approach to work, consistently ensuring data accuracy, reliability, and completeness
Advanced fluency in SQL and Python, or similar programming languages, for complex data manipulation, modelling, automation, and analysis
Proficiency with Google Cloud Platform, etc.
